testcase.name: unstarted cancelled missing and duplicate DNS observations are incomplete rather than failures
legacy DNS_FAILURE and short duration cannot identify root cause
network instability missing snapshots and global stops suppress operational settings advice
system timeout with conflicting raw protocol results does not advance to settings review
ERROR_SYSTEM with known unknown or missing errno is not a resolver replacement diagnosis
advice is deterministic preserves evidence and omits query and network identifiers
permission and invalid argument require API investigation even when raw DNS succeeds
raw truncation negative and protocol difference retain independent observations
parse and unknown resolver errors retain platform code without claiming poisoning
stable same host timeout offers conditional reversible reviews without choosing a provider
unfinished and cancelled attempt records cannot be hidden by complete aggregate fields
Private DNS active does not block explicit plain protocol diagnostics or recommend disabling it
no evidence and demonstration do not diagnose the current phone
HTTPS failure with successful DNS is not a DNS provider recommendation
NXDOMAIN checks name and policy without suggesting DNS replacement
successful addresses do not require settings changes or claim HTTPS coverage
different missing invalid and redacted system hosts cannot justify settings advice
same host difference is bounded and normalized but does not prove same lookup type
empty NOERROR and other response codes ask for bounded evidence
mixed retries retain first failure and require more evidence instead of settings changes
source record and baseline provenance do not claim live settings or repair success
